title: Gather Frenzy
description: A fast-paced overhaul that makes mining, farming, and resource gathering more fun, dynamic, and rewarding with combo-based mechanics.
body:
![Title : Gather Frenzy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5cf0bcb43157fda22ae453ac32b10a84b7458c9a.png)

> Tired of slow and repetitive grinding ?
 
  Mining, farming, are now fast, satisfying, and combo-driven.
 ->Every block you break builds up a combo.
 ->Farm ressources more quickly
    for small games or helpful for big farms.

- Break blocks quickly to increase your combo
- Keep the momentum or lose it
- The higher your combo, the better the rewards

Combo effects : (For Crops)

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

All effects stack with each other
(Combo 3 = Combo 1 + 2 + 3)

> Combo > 5:
Speed I

> Combo > 20:
10% chance to double drops
Haste I

> Combo > 40:
20% chance to double drops
15% chance to triple drops
Speed II
10% chance to drop an XP orb

> Combo > 75:
Haste II
SUPER FARMER effect (increased reach + knockback resistance)
100% chance to double drops
15% chance to triple drops
7% chance to quadruple drops
25% chance to drop an XP orb

> Combo > 100:
Speed III
SUPER FARMER II
Saturation I
Haste III
100% chance to double drops again (+2 total)
15% chance for x5 drops
3% chance for x9 drops
40% chance to drop an XP orb

</details>

Bonus drops based on your combo
Dynamic sounds that scale with your combo
